description.en:
This dataset includes data from population register. For each building is given: building ID, planned usage, municipality and county, coordinates and address.

The dataset includes all building for which coordinates are known, and which have at least post code as address.

The original data (15.8.2016) was in CSV format, it was changed to Shape-format by Kylli Ek (CSC).

Coordinate Reference System: ETRS89 / ETRS-TM35FIN (EPSG:3067) 

Previous name of dataset creator organization: Population Register Center.

creator: Digital and Population Data Services Agency

values: Digi- ja väestötietovirasto / Finnish Digital Agency
